## EA Media Tools 1.1.0 — ea-video

### Stable and prerelease FFmpeg channels

- Stable and latest-prerelease Jellyfin FFmpeg builds are downloaded, verified, and kept separately.
- The welcome-page gear menu has a persisted **Stable** switch. The status bar identifies the active release with a green stable or yellow prerelease indicator.
- Changing channels reruns hardware capability checks against the selected binary.

### Closed-caption extraction and future audio tooling

- Compatible platforms download CCExtractor 0.96.6 or newer from the official release feed.
- The Subtitles tab can extract embedded CEA-608/708 captions to a temporary SRT and remux them into MP4, MKV, or WebM output.
- Caption staging files are cleaned after completion, failure, cancellation, shutdown, and update restart.
- rsgain 3.7 is downloaded and verified under `lib/rsgain` for a future ReplayGain stage.

### Updates, quality, and progress

- The splash screen completes the application update check before settings, runtime, and GPU initialization.
- Background checks run every 15 minutes. Restarting for an update cleanly cancels active encodes first.
- Streaming output at the 1080p source or scale tier now uses CQ 28.
- **Done** remains absent while any job is pending or active and appears only when all jobs complete or cancel.

### Validation

- Lint, native and compatibility TypeScript checks, unit tests, and production packaging.
- SHA-256 verification for managed release archives when GitHub supplies a digest.

[Review all changes since v1.0.0](https://github.com/eaforlife/media-converter/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0).
